tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text, amounts, line icons, the dark pill button and the floating tab bar. Also the outline colour inside illustrations. Reads on every surface and soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels above amounts, dates, helper lines. Reads on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunk` (5.2:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Kobo after a big amount (₦34,567.90) and placeholder text, on `surface-raised` only, at 20px or larger. Never for words the user must read.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `ink` (the dark pill button, the tab bar).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: a soft cool grey that lets white cards float without borders.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows, sheets, the search field and white icon circles.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Grey pills and circles: secondary buttons, quick action circles, unselected filter chips, keypad keys, icon circles inside white cards.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and the dashed divider inside cards. Cards themselves have no border.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Kolo Blue. Primary buttons, the selected filter chip, the add button, the balance card, focus rings. `on-blue` text on it (4.7:1). Not for text on grey; use `blue-ink`.

tokens.name: blue-glow
tokens.usage: The light spot in the balance card gradient, behind large white amounts only (34px+).

tokens.name: blue-ink
tokens.usage: Blue as text: links, Partial/Info pill text, selected labels. Reads on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `blue-soft`.

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Info pills and notices, the selected member chip, illustration grounds.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `blue`.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Market Orange: illustrations, the turn ring on the coin tracker, the due dot. Not a button colour in the app UI.

tokens.name: orange-ink
tokens.usage: Due soon text and pill text. Reads on `surface-raised` and `orange-soft`.

tokens.name: orange-soft
tokens.usage: Due pill and due notice background.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Coin gold: illustrations, the star on the member who collects. `ink` text on it.

tokens.name: sun-soft
tokens.usage: Celebration sheet background and the Sent/Waiting pill.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Naira green: paid coins, illustrations. White check marks on it are icons, not text.

tokens.name: green-ink
tokens.usage: Paid text and +₦ amounts. Reads on `surface-raised` and `green-soft`.

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: Paid pill and success notice background.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Missed and errors only, as text on `surface-raised` and `red-soft`, or as a fill with white. Always with the alert icon and a word.

tokens.name: red-soft
tokens.usage: Missed pill and error notice background.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Illustration ground only.

tokens.name: skin-deep
tokens.usage: Illustration skin, darker tone.

tokens.name: skin-mid
tokens.usage: Illustration skin, middle tone.

tokens.name: skin-light
tokens.usage: Illustration skin, lighter tone.

tokens.name: skin-shade
tokens.usage: The single flat shadow tone on all skin in illustrations.

styles.name: amount-hero
styles.usage: The one balance or payout on a screen. Kobo in `ink-subtle`.

styles.name: amount-lg
styles.usage: Contribution on group cards, the keypad readout, receipt totals.

styles.name: amount-md
styles.usage: Amounts in list rows and receipt lines.

styles.name: bar-title
styles.usage: Centred title in the top bar on detail screens.

styles.name: celebrate
styles.usage: Celebration sheets and onboarding headlines next to an illustration. The only place the display face appears.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Instructions the user must act on.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default copy, row titles at weight 500.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, tab labels, quick action labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Dates and secondary row lines. The smallest text in the app.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked list cards and between keypad keys.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between a card's icon and text; button gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side margin and inner card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large card padding (balance, receipt).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space around a hero illustration.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small tiles and the inner corners of keypad keys.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: List row cards, notices, keypad keys.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards: balance, ajo group, receipt sections.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The outer frame around a card group (the double rim look) and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, pills, icon circles, avatars, the tab bar.

shadow.note: Soft and quiet. Cards lift off the grey page with light; only floating things (tab bar, add button) cast a real shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: White cards and list rows on `surface`.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The floating tab bar, the add button and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-blue
tokens.usage: Under the primary button and the balance card.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Pressed states and cards inside cards.

size.note: Hit areas and object sizes. Market fingers are busy: everything tappable is big.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, rows, chips and the search field.

tokens.name: tap-key
tokens.usage: Keypad keys and the quick action circles.

tokens.name: icon-circle
tokens.usage: Round icon buttons in the top bar and icon circles in list rows.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Line icons everywhere in the interface.

tokens.name: spot
tokens.usage: Two tone spot icons in notices and empty states.

tokens.name: avatar
tokens.usage: Member avatars.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Stroke of every line icon.
